subject: Taxes
title: The Minimum Book Tax
description: Learn The Minimum Book Tax in one minute.

hook.text: In 2022, the US created a 15% minimum tax on book income for companies earning over $1 billion.

buildup.text: Book income is what companies report to shareholders—the 'real' profit.

discovery.text: The Corporate Alternative Minimum Tax ensures that even with deductions.

twist.text: Only about 150 companies are affected. But they include the most high-profile zero-tax offenders like Amazon, Nike.

climax.text: The book minimum tax is a blunt instrument—it sacrifices precision for political optics.

punchline.text: 150 companies, 15% minimum. No more billion-dollar zero-tax bills.

quiz.question: What does the Corporate Alternative Minimum Tax ensure?
options: Billion-dollar companies pay at least 15% on book income
